subject: Staggered PO claims, VAT reconciliation & AP onboarding packet
messages:
From: Ellen Marsh <ellen.marsh@heliosretail.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: James O'Neill <j.oneill@heliosretail.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-12 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Vendor registration & PO handling questions

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to add Redwood as a registered supplier in our AP portal, but our billing team flagged a few requirements before we can activate PO linking: 

• We require a vendor legal name match to our master record (company name + registration number).
• Every invoice must include the originating PO number in line-level metadata when we receive split invoices across charge types (software license vs. services).
• For EU customers we need VAT registration evidence (or a VAT self-cert) and an assigned invoice tax category per line.
• Portal access: once registered, we ask vendors to upload an onboarding packet (banking + W9/W8 or VAT self-cert + contact person). We can accept a signed DocuSign packet or PDFs.

Can you confirm Redwood's preferred legal name to use, provide a sample invoice that shows how you'll handle split PO claims (we have cases where one PO maps to multiple invoice lines across cost centers), and attach your VAT document? Also please let me know who will be our AP contact for any remittance or file-based PTP integration.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our cutover to the new portal for vendor onboarding is next Thursday (2026-08-19).

Best,
Ellen
AP Operations | Helios Retail

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Marsh <ellen.marsh@heliosretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-12 12:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO handling questions

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and I've attached the onboarding packet and a sample CSV invoice that demonstrates our split-line approach.

Legal name to register: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Company reg / VAT: GB 997 6543 21 (we'll attach the VAT self-cert)
AP contact: Laura Bennett, Finance Operations Lead (laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com) — cc'd here. Phone: +1 415-555-0192.

PO / invoice mapping: we can surface the PO number at both the invoice header and the individual line level. In cases where a single PO funds multiple GL cost centers, our billing engine will emit the following fields per line: PO_NUMBER, PO_LINE_REF, SERVICE_CODE, TAX_CATEGORY, COST_CENTER. The sample_invoice_for_po_7453.csv shows two lines under PO 7453 split between "License" and "Implementation" cost buckets.

File formats we can provide: PDF invoices, line-item CSV (for bulk uploads), and UBL/e-invoice payloads on request. For the vendor portal, we can upload the packet as a signed PDF (DocuSign accepted) — I've attached the packet and our bank details text file for EFT.

Open items from our side: please confirm whether Helios requires separate remit-to addresses per cost center or a single remit-to. Also let us know if your portal requires the vendor to create a login tied to a vendor code (we can surface Vendor Code: REDW-UK-001).

Attachments: Helios_AP_Onboarding_Form.pdf (blank, to sign), Redwood_VAT_SelfCert.pdf, sample_invoice_for_po_7453.csv, redwood-bank-details.txt

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Dylan / Laura —

Thanks for the packet. We received the signed onboarding form via DocuSign and uploaded the vendor record to our portal this morning (Vendor ID: HLS-2026-9921). The portal validated the VAT number but flagged one line on your sample invoice as reverse-charge-eligible — our tax team requires an explicit note in the line "TAX_CATEGORY" for reverse-charge.

Next steps: 
• Laura — please email the sample invoice with TAX_CATEGORY set to "REVERSE_CHARGE_EU" for the affected line and re-upload to the portal (or we can accept a corrected CSV reply).
• Ellen will create a test PO (7453-TEST) and send it to Redwood's billing address — please submit a test invoice referencing that PO so we can validate matching rules.

James — I'll add the remittance details to the vendor record for EFT after we confirm the final remit-to address (per Redwood's uploaded bank-details file).

Appreciate the quick work — I'll keep the portal open for updates through Friday.

Best,
Ellen
AP Operations | Helios Retail
